documents.title: Safe Refund Reconciliation Rules and Principles on Tiki
documents.snippet:
Safe Refund Reconciliation Rules and Principles on Tiki
Refund requests are only processed once an order has been successfully canceled prior to dispatch, or after the Tiki warehouse receives and inspects the returned product to standard. All refund decisions must undergo reconciliation by authorized customer service personnel; AI is prohibited from autonomously approving monetary transactions. Original shipping fees are non-refundable if the return reason is based on personal preference.

documents.title: Order Cancellation Rules and Conditions on Tiki
documents.snippet:
Order Cancellation Rules and Conditions on Tiki
Customers can click 'Cancel Order' directly on the Tiki app if the order is in 'Processing' or 'Awaiting Packing' status and has not yet been handed over to the shipping carrier. Once the order transitions to 'In Transit', the direct cancellation button is disabled; customers should reject the package upon courier contact. For canceled prepaid orders, refunds will be issued automatically according to Tiki refund policies.

documents.title: Restricted Return Categories and Non-Returnable Change-of-Mind Items on Tiki
documents.snippet:
Restricted Return Categories and Non-Returnable Change-of-Mind Items on Tiki
Product categories that do not support returns due to change of mind or personal preference include: Underwear, swimwear, cosmetics and chemicals with unsealed protective packaging, Tiki Ngon fresh groceries, dietary supplements, mobile top-up scratch cards, electronic service vouchers, and clearance outlet items marked as non-returnable. These items are only eligible for return or exchange if Tiki delivered an incorrect item or if there is a verified manufacturer defect.

documents.title: Refund Receipt Timeline by Payment Method on Tiki
documents.snippet:
Refund Receipt Timeline by Payment Method on Tiki
The timeline for receiving a refund on Tiki depends on the original payment method: For Tiki Coins Wallet, refunds are credited within 24 hours. For linked e-wallets (MoMo, ZaloPay, VNPay, Viettel Money), funds are returned to the wallet within 1-2 business days. For domestic Napas ATM cards, the timeline is 3-5 business days. For international credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, JCB), issuing banks process within 7-15 business days (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays).

documents.title: Handling Payment Incidents and Banking Transactions on Tiki
documents.snippet:
Handling Payment Incidents and Banking Transactions on Tiki
If a customer's bank account or e-wallet is debited but the order on Tiki remains in 'Awaiting Payment' status or fails to display, this is typically due to transmission latency from the payment gateway. The Tiki system and payment gateway automatically reconcile and update the order within 15-30 minutes. If the order remains unconfirmed after 1 hour, the system will automatically refund the original payment account within 24-72 business hours.

documents.title: Handling Double Deductions on Credit Cards or E-Wallets
documents.snippet:
Handling Double Deductions on Credit Cards or E-Wallets
In instances where network congestion causes a transaction to be recorded and charged twice for the same Tiki order code, Tiki's automated reconciliation system and partner banks will detect the duplicate charge during end-of-day settlement and refund the excess amount to the card within 48 business hours without requiring a formal dispute claim.

documents.snippet:
Checking Refund History and Order Status on Tiki
Customers can monitor refund progress by accessing 'Account Details' > 'Return & Refund Management'. Refund statuses include: 'Reconciliation Processing' (under customer support review), 'Transferred to Bank' (funds dispatched from Tiki, awaiting bank credit), and 'Refund Succeeded' along with the bank's transaction tracing reference code.

Customers can check order status by navigating to 'My Orders' on the Tiki app. Order statuses include: 'Pending Confirmation' (seller preparing), 'Pick Up in Progress' (packed, awaiting courier), 'In Transit' (courier delivering, real-time tracking code provided), 'Delivered' (completed), and 'Canceled'. documents.title: Handling Delayed, Lost, or Discrepant Delivery Statuses
documents.snippet:
Handling Delayed, Lost, or Discrepant Delivery Statuses
In the event a Tiki order exceeds its estimated delivery date without arrival, or if a courier marks an order as 'Successfully Delivered' when the customer has not received the parcel, the customer must contact Tiki Customer Support within 24-48 hours via hotline 1900 6035. Tiki's dispatch team will verify courier GPS logs, coordinate with the delivery hub, and resolve the complaint. If an order is lost, Tiki will dispatch a replacement or issue a 100% refund.

documents.title: Instructions for Changing Delivery Address or Phone Number After Placing Order
documents.snippet:
Instructions for Changing Delivery Address or Phone Number After Placing Order
Customers may change the delivery address or phone number only once per order, provided the order remains in 'Pending Processing' status. When an order advances to 'Preparing Items' or 'Handed Over to Courier', modification features are locked to prevent parcel misrouting. Customers should contact the courier upon phone contact to arrange delivery at a nearby location.

documents.title: Handling Delayed, Lost, or Discrepant Delivery Statuses
documents.snippet:
Handling Delayed, Lost, or Discrepant Delivery Statuses
In the event a Tiki order exceeds its estimated delivery date without arrival, or if a courier marks an order as 'Successfully Delivered' when the customer has not received the parcel, the customer must contact Tiki Customer Support within 24-48 hours via hotline 1900 6035. Tiki's dispatch team will verify courier GPS logs, coordinate with the delivery hub, and resolve the complaint. If an order is lost, Tiki will dispatch a replacement or issue a 100% refund.

documents.title: Instructions for Changing Delivery Address or Phone Number After Placing Order
documents.snippet:
Instructions for Changing Delivery Address or Phone Number After Placing Order
Customers may change the delivery address or phone number only once per order, provided the order remains in 'Pending Processing' status. When an order advances to 'Preparing Items' or 'Handed Over to Courier', modification features are locked to prevent parcel misrouting. Customers should contact the courier upon phone contact to arrange delivery at a nearby location.

documents.title: Handling Payment Incidents and Banking Transactions on Tiki
documents.snippet:
Handling Payment Incidents and Banking Transactions on Tiki
If a customer's bank account or e-wallet is debited but the order on Tiki remains in 'Awaiting Payment' status or fails to display, this is typically due to transmission latency from the payment gateway. The Tiki system and payment gateway automatically reconcile and update the order within 15-30 minutes. If the order remains unconfirmed after 1 hour, the system will automatically refund the original payment account within 24-72 business hours.

documents.title: Checking Refund History and Order Status on Tiki
documents.snippet:
Checking Refund History and Order Status on Tiki
Customers can monitor refund progress by accessing 'Account Details' > 'Return & Refund Management'. Refund statuses include: 'Reconciliation Processing' (under customer support review), 'Transferred to Bank' (funds dispatched from Tiki, awaiting bank credit), and 'Refund Succeeded' along with the bank's transaction tracing reference code.
